	if = { limit = { province_owner = { has_trait = education_adeanic_knight_3 } } add = -0.45 } # traits education_adeanic_knight_3
	if = { limit = { province_owner = { has_trait = education_adeanic_knight_4 } } add = -0.6 } # traits education_adeanic_knight_4
	if = { limit = { province_owner = { has_trait = education_adeanic_knight_5 } } add = -0.75 } # traits education_adeanic_knight_5
	if = { limit = { province_owner = { has_trait = family_first } province_owner.culture = { has_cultural_parameter = bonuses_from_patriarch_matriarch_trait } } add = 0.1 } # traits family_first
	if = { limit = { province_owner = { has_trait = torturer } } add = 0.1 } # traits torturer
}

# Province scope: the correction tier, aov_holding_levy_size_bonus / 0.05 rounded, clamped to -20..60.
aov_holding_levy_tier = {
	value = aov_holding_levy_size_bonus
	divide = 0.05
	round = yes
	min = -20
	max = 60
}
